007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model;
008
009import java.util.Locale;
010
011/**
012 * OCI Generative AI API formats currently recognized by the SDK.
013 * <p>
014 * This enum is used for creation and update validation. Existing database
015 * profile metadata may contain a newer format and is preserved as a string
016 * during hydration.
017 *
018 * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/autonomous-database/serverless/adbsb/select-ai-manage-profiles.html">
019 *      Select AI profile provider configuration</a>
020 */
021public enum OciApiFormat {
022    /** OCI endpoint uses Cohere-compatible request/response format. */
023    COHERE("COHERE"),
024    /** OCI endpoint uses the generic chat API format. */
025    GENERIC("GENERIC");
026
027    /** DBMS_CLOUD_AI OCI API format value. */
028    private final String value;
029
030    OciApiFormat(String value) {
031        this.value = value;
032    }
033
034    /**
035     * Returns the DBMS_CLOUD_AI OCI API format value.
036     *
037     * @return OCI API format value
038     */
039    public String getValue() {
040        return value;
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * Parses an OCI API format value.
045     *
046     * @param value OCI API format supplied to a creation or update builder
047     * @return matching OCI API format, or {@code null} when input is null/blank
048     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when value is not a supported OCI API format
049     */
050    public static OciApiFormat fromValue(String value) {
051        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
052            return null;
053        }
054        String normalized = value.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
055        return switch (normalized) {
056            case "COHERE" -> COHERE;
057            case "GENERIC" -> GENERIC;
058            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
059                    "ociApiformat must be either COHERE or GENERIC");
060        };
061    }
062}
